title: The ideal structure of Exel-Pardo algebras and their higher rank analogues
summary: Given a pseudo-free self-similar action of a countable group $G$ on a countable directed graph $E$ with amenable stabilizers of the vertices, we identify the exact conditions under which these stabilizers do not contribute to the ideal structure of the corresponding Exel-Pardo algebra $\mathcal{O}_{G,E}$. Under these conditions, we give a complete description of the primitive ideal space of $\mathcal{O}_{G,E}$ in graph-theoretic terms.
